ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_MINUTES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
function check_minutes ( hrs_and_min in number )
return boolean is
begin
 if hrs_and_min - floor (hrs_and_min) > 0.59
 then
 return false;
 else return true;
 end if;
end;
